projectStoryImage.scope.en: Choose and crop a local story image, then explicitly upload it. Apply the returned reference to this captured chapter and save the local draft. This does not publish or approve the story.
projectStoryImage.scope.zh-Hans: 选择并裁剪本地故事图片，再明确上传。将返回的引用应用到此次捕获的章节并保存本地草稿。此操作不会发布或批准故事。

projectStoryImage.changed.en: The draft has changed. Save any received receipt, then close and reopen this field before choosing another image.
projectStoryImage.changed.zh-Hans: 草稿已变化。请先保存已收到的回执，再关闭并重新打开此字段后选择图片。

projectStoryImage.previewScope.en: Preview of the selected, sanitized image on this device. The uploaded bytes are not fetched through this preview.
projectStoryImage.previewScope.zh-Hans: 这是本机所选图片经清除元数据后的预览，此预览不会读取已上传的图片。

projectStoryImage.notUploaded.en: This selection has not been uploaded.

projectStoryImage.unstored.en: Your image was uploaded but couldn't be saved on this device. Save it before applying it. It's kept only while the app stays open.
projectStoryImage.unstored.zh-Hans: 图片已上传，但未能保存在本机。请先保存再应用，此信息仅在应用保持打开时保留。

projectStoryImage.saveReceipt.zh-Hans: 保存已收到的引用回执

projectStoryImage.referenceScope.en: Image uploaded. This doesn't confirm that you own it or that it has passed review.
projectStoryImage.referenceScope.zh-Hans: 图片已上传。这不代表你拥有其版权或已通过审核。

projectStoryImage.referenceTooLong.en: The returned reference exceeds the story's existing 500-character limit. Its receipt is retained, but it cannot be applied.
projectStoryImage.referenceTooLong.zh-Hans: 返回的引用超过故事现有的500字符限制。回执会保留，但无法应用。

projectStoryImage.apply.en: Apply to this chapter and save locally
projectStoryImage.apply.zh-Hans: 应用到此章节并保存到本地

projectStoryImage.unknown.en: We couldn't confirm whether your upload went through. Uploading again starts a new upload.
projectStoryImage.unknown.zh-Hans: 无法确认上次上传是否成功。重新上传会创建新的上传。

projectStoryImage.localFailed.en: Local draft or application receipt saving did not complete. The original upload receipt is retained. Retry the local save; no upload will be sent.
projectStoryImage.localFailed.zh-Hans: 本地草稿或应用回执尚未保存完成。原上传回执已保留。请重试本地保存，不会再次上传。

projectStoryImage.failed.en: The local record could not be verified. Existing story references remain available.
projectStoryImage.failed.zh-Hans: 无法核实本地记录。现有故事引用仍然保留。

projectStoryImage.unavailable.en: Image upload isn't available right now, or this chapter hasn't been saved yet. Existing images are kept.
projectStoryImage.unavailable.zh-Hans: 图片上传暂不可用，或此章节尚未保存。现有图片会保留。

projectStoryImage.unauthorized.en: Sign in again before uploading another story image. The unresolved attempt is retained.
projectStoryImage.unauthorized.zh-Hans: 请重新登录后再上传故事图片。尚未确认的尝试会保留。
